about: The collecta of the formulary “Third Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal. Page 45 prints the proper body and short Per Dóminum cue. The complete conclusion is a declared composite of pages 123 and 226 under RG115a, not a continuous proper-page transcription.

seg.tr: Almighty, everlasting God, look graciously upon our weakness and stretch out the right hand of Your majesty to protect us. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: stretch out the right hand of Your majesty

ex.w006: The adjective describes God, the unexpressed subject of “réspice” (w007): look upon our weakness, being gracious. A predicate of the subject of an imperative stands in the nominative.
